messages:
jamie_r: p0 customer (acme-prod) hit intermittent 0-length embeddings + dimension mismatch after upgrading to ts-sdk@2.4. Spiking billing and vector store shows some items with length 0. Request id: rq_8f3b9c2e

maria_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the request_id, a minimal repro and any client logs?

jamie_r: request id above. quick repro (ts):
```ts
// tiny repro using official ts client
const sdk = new RedwoodEmbeddings({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const docs = [...Array(40)].map((i) => `doc-${i}`); // concurrency test
await Promise.all(Array.from({length: 8}).map(() =>
  sdk.embed.batch({ inputs: docs, model: 'open-embed-1' })
));
```
Observations: batch_size 32, concurrency ~8-10, client timeout 10s. We see some responses with empty vectors: `vectors: [[], [0.12,...]]` and later a retry produces a second (valid) vector for same input (duplicate billing).

aaron_engml: can you paste the raw response body (redact text) for one of the failing requests and the client debug log around the retry? Also include server-side request-id header if present.

jamie_r: raw body (redacted):
```json
{"request_id":"rq_8f3b9c2e","status":200,"embeddings":[[],[0.003,0.12,...]],"meta":{"model":"open-embed-1","seq_len":128}}
```
client log snippet:
```
[2026-02-12T15:02:01Z] DEBUG send rq_8f3b9c2e payload 32
[2026-02-12T15:02:11Z] WARN timeout after 10000ms for rq_8f3b9c2e
[2026-02-12T15:02:11Z] DEBUG retrying rq_8f3b9c2e attempt=1
[2026-02-12T15:02:11Z] INFO sent retry rq_8f3b9c2e
[2026-02-12T15:02:12Z] DEBUG received rq_8f3b9c2e body status=200 embeddings=[0.002,0.11,...]
```
Looks like initial response arrived but client timed out before body parsed -> retry sent -> server processed again producing second vector. Also saw some responses where server returned an embedding with empty array (length 0) and status 200.

maria_support: thanks. tagging infra/eng-runtime and eng-ml. @sara_runtime @aaron_engml please triage. I'll open a support incident and notify customer.

escalation-bot: Incident created INC-2026-8823 (priority: high) — linked to rq_8f3b9c2e :rotating_light:

aaron_engml: first-pass thoughts: two separate issues:
1) empty-array embeddings -> likely server-side model failure or a serialization bug when KV cache missing chunk. Need logs from inference pods for that request_id.
2) duplicate billing from retries -> client-side: opaque retries when a response body was in-flight; server accepted and completed. Need idempotency token or dedupe at server. Also check our SDK retry/backoff impl: appears to retry immediately on timeout without jitter and without an idempotency header.

tim_ops: I've checked node autoscaler around the time — there were short-lived pod restarts on node ip-10-2-4 causing increased latency. Could correlate with seq_len spikes. I'll attach kube logs if needed.

jamie_r: attaching small stress script we used. Also saw same behavior in python client (py-embed v1.9) when concurrency high. Workaround we applied: filter out empty strings before sending and set client timeout to 30s. That reduced duplicates but didn't fix empty embeddings.

sara_runtime: assigned to eng-runtime. Immediate asks: (a) eng-runtime: fetch inference pod logs for rq_8f3b9c2e and surrounding minute, include model runner stderr/stdout; (b) eng-ml: check model autoregressive/kvcache code path for edgecases returning zero-length embedding; (c) eng-devex: reproduce internally with ts-sdk@2.4 and a network-delay simulator.

aaron_engml: noted. Quick mitigation suggestion for customers: server will accept Idempotency-Key header to dedupe repeated requests within 5m. If client sets a deterministic id (hash of inputs + model + batch index) we can skip double-processing. We'll add a short doc, but need runtime support to enable the dedupe header behavior for embeddings endpoint.

maria_support: @jamie_r can you ask acme to set a temporary Idempotency-Key? We'll route traffic through a special dedupe path if present. Also we'll offer a billing credit for duplicate charges while we investigate.

jamie_r: will ask customer. Also: small repro that consistently returns empty array when one of inputs is an empty string or very long > 10k chars. So we did a quick filter and that removed the zero-lengths 100%. Maybe server currently returns [] for invalid inputs instead of an error.

sara_runtime: thanks — we'll change server behavior to return 4xx for invalid inputs (empty string / > limit) rather than 200 empty embedding. That should make clients safer. Also eng-runtime will add body-level ack before pruning request so client timeouts don't cause reprocess duplicates.

aaron_engml: for SDKs we'll push a patch to ts/python: include jittered exponential backoff by default and attach an Idempotency-Key header computed from input hash. Also we'll document recommended client-side dedupe and set default timeout to 30s for batch endpoints.

maria_support: next steps: 1) eng-runtime to fetch logs and implement 4xx for invalid inputs + idempotency dedupe (ETA 48h) 2) SDKs to release patch with idempotency header and improved backoff (ETA 72h) 3) support to offer credit and advise customer to use temporary Idempotency-Key and increase timeout (done)

sara_runtime: acked. I have a runbook item to search for other request_ids with empty embeddings in last 30d and will report back.

jamie_r: thanks everyone. customer asked for timeline — I'll tell them we have fix & SDK patch in progress and a short-term dedupe path + credit. :thumbsup:

maria_support: closing loop once eng-runtime posts logs and PRs.

sara_runtime: FYI created PR #9876 to return 400 on empty inputs and add server-side dedupe by Idempotency-Key. Will post link when ready.

aaron_engml: creating SDK PRs for ts/python to add idempotency header + jittered backoff.

jamie_r: customer ok with workaround. marking as monitored.

maria_support: thanks all — escalating resolved->monitoring, reopen if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
